paper.title_en: Periodic Orbits of Van der Waals Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: Black holes in asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime whose extended-phase-space thermodynamics reproduces that of a van der Waals fluid exactly form a distinctive class, the van der Waals black holes (VBHs). The timelike geodesics of VBHs are solved, their periodic orbits are catalogued, and the gravitational waves emitted along them are computed, so as to trace how the thermodynamic pressure P and the molecular-volume parameter b shape the orbital dynamics. Integrating the geodesic equations numerically yields the energy, angular momentum and radius of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) and maps out the family of bound orbits. To delimit the parameter window in which the effective potential stays well behaved, we introduce a critical angular momentum Ls. Within the orbit-classification scheme, we compute the energies corresponding to rational q for several parameter sets and display the resulting orbits. The waveforms produced along these orbits are generated within the "Kludge" formalism, which makes it possible to quantify the imprint of b on the wave amplitude and on the period. Both the orbital architecture and the gravitational-wave signature turn out to be strongly sensitive to b. The dynamical behavior of VBHs and Schwarzschild-AdS (SAdS) black holes differs markedly, providing a new perspective for probing black hole thermodynamics via gravitational wave observations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究范德瓦尔斯黑洞的周期轨道与引力波特征，主题属于黑洞热力学与扩展相空间，方法涉及测地线数值积分与Kludge引力波计算，理论深度与清晰度较好，但创新性中等，且尚未有引用记录，总体值得关注。
decision.title_zh: 范德瓦尔斯黑洞的周期轨道
decision.abstract_zh: 在渐近反德西特（AdS）时空中，其扩展相空间热力学精确再现范德瓦尔斯流体行为的黑洞构成了一类独特的黑洞，即范德瓦尔斯黑洞（VBHs）。本文求解了VBHs的类时测地线，编目了它们的周期轨道，并计算了沿这些轨道发射的引力波，从而追踪热力学压强P和分子体积参数b如何塑造轨道动力学。对测地线方程进行数值积分，得到了最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）的能量、角动量和半径，并绘制了束缚轨道的族。为了界定有效势保持良好行为的参数窗口，我们引入了一个临界角动量Ls。在轨道分类方案内，我们为若干参数集计算了对应于有理数q的能量，并展示了所得轨道。沿这些轨道产生的波形是在“Kludge”形式框架内生成的，这使得量化b对波振幅和周期的影响成为可能。轨道结构和引力波特征均对b表现出强烈敏感性。VBHs与施瓦茨席尔德-AdS（SAdS）黑洞的动力学行为显著不同，为通过引力波观测探测黑洞热力学提供了新视角。
